verdicts.explanation: The paper reports 4 x 10-4 S/cm at room temperature for the 0.10 Ce sample (Li6.4Ga0.2La3Zr1.9Ce0.1O12) in the abstract, Section 3.4.1 and Table 2, with Ea 0.29 eV, 1050 C/8 h sintering, and 95.96% relative density all matching the paper.

Table 2 gives 2.41 x 10-5 S/cm and 0.44 eV for the 0 Ce composition, and Section 2.1 gives the 1050 C/8 h sintering that applies to all samples; the null relative density is correct because no value is given for this composition.
Table 2 gives 9.93 x 10-5 S/cm and 0.34 eV for the 0.20 Ce composition, with sintering conditions from Section 2.1 applying to all samples.
Table 2 gives 4.26 x 10-5 S/cm and 0.41 eV for the 0.30 Ce composition, with sintering conditions from Section 2.1 applying to all samples.
